fields.name: Dominate
fields.effect_text: Before or after movement, you may move an enemy minion in radius up to 2 spaces; ignore heavy minion immunity.

fields.name: Final Embrace
fields.effect_text: End of round: Defeat an enemy melee or ranged minion adjacent to you.

fields.name: Devoted Followers
fields.effect_text: If you are adjacent to an enemy unit, you may retrieve a discarded card.

fields.name: Turn into Statues
fields.effect_text: Next turn: Enemy heroes in radius count as both heroes and terrain, and cannot perform movement actions.

fields.name: Lethal Spin
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. +3 :attack: Attack for each other enemy unit adjacent to you.

fields.name: Rapid Thrusts
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range. +1 :range: Range for each enemy unit adjacent to you. May repeat once on a different enemy hero.

fields.name: Siren's Call
fields.effect_text: Target an enemy unit not adjacent to you and in range; if able, move the target up to 3 spaces to a space adjacent to you.

fields.name: Cleave
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. After the attack: May repeat once on a different enemy hero. (You may repeat even if the original target was a minion.)

fields.name: Charm
fields.effect_text: Before or after movement, you may move an enemy ranged minion in radius up to 2 spaces.

fields.name: Stone Gaze
fields.effect_text: Next turn: Enemy heroes in radius count as both heroes and terrain, and cannot perform movement actions. (If you move, the radius "moves" with you.)

fields.name: Threatening Slash
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. +1 :attack: Attack for each other enemy unit adjacent to you. (Do not count the target when calculating the attack bonus.)

fields.name: Long Thrust
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range. +1 :range: Range for each enemy unit adjacent to you.

fields.name: Deadly Swipe
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. +2 :attack: Attack for each other enemy unit adjacent to you.

fields.name: Fresh Converts
fields.effect_text: If you are adjacent to an enemy minion, you may retrieve a discarded card.

fields.name: Petrifying Stare
fields.effect_text: Next turn: Enemy heroes in radius count as both heroes and terrain, and cannot perform movement actions.

fields.name: Constrict
fields.effect_text: End of round: Defeat an enemy melee minion adjacent to you. (Before the end of round minion battle.)

fields.name: Control
fields.effect_text: Before or after movement, you may move an enemy ranged or melee minion in radius up to 2 spaces.

fields.name: Metamorphosis
fields.effect_text: Gain +1 :movement: Movement and +1 :initiative: Initiative for each enemy unit adjacent to you. You may move through obstacles.

fields.name: Flame Belcher
fields.effect_text:
Target a unit in range adjacent to the Turret.
May repeat up to two times on different enemy units.

fields.name: Supercharged Cannon
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range of both you and the Turret. If the target is in a straight line from you and in a straight line from the Turret, gain +3 :attack: Attack.

fields.name: Deployable Bastion
fields.effect_text: Place up to 3 :barrier_token: Barrier tokens in radius, with at least one of them adjacent to the Turret; you and friendly heroes gain +1 :defense: Defense for each Barrier token they are adjacent to.

fields.name: Disruptor Grid
fields.effect_text: This turn: Before any enemy hero in radius of the Turret performs a primary action, that hero discards a card, or is defeated; if they discard a card, deactivate this effect.

fields.name: Emergency Protocol
fields.effect_text: Up to two enemy heroes in radius of the Turret discard a card, or are defeated. Remove the Turret.

fields.name: Perfected Design
fields.effect_text:
If you are in radius of the Turret, Choose one —
• Swap with a unit or a token in radius of the Turret.
• Place yourself into a space in radius of the Turret.

fields.name: Steam Discharge
fields.effect_text:
Target a unit in range adjacent to the Turret.
May repeat once on a different enemy unit.

fields.name: Gatling Gun
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range of both you and the Turret. If the target is in a straight line from you, and in a straight line from the Turret, gain +2 :attack: Attack.

fields.name: Deployable Barrier
fields.effect_text: Place up to 2 :barrier_token: Barrier tokens in radius, with at least one of them adjacent to the Turret; you and friendly heroes gain +1 :defense: Defense for each Barrier token they are adjacent to.

fields.name: Disruptor Pulse
fields.effect_text: This turn: Before any enemy hero in radius of the Turret performs a primary action, that hero discards a card, if able; if they discard a card, deactivate this effect.

fields.name: Self-Destruct
fields.effect_text: Up to two enemy heroes in radius of the Turret discard a card, if able. Remove the Turret.

fields.name: Updated Design
fields.effect_text: If you are in radius of the Turret, swap with a unit or a token in radius of the Turret.

fields.name: Salvage Parts
fields.effect_text:
Choose one —
• Place the Turret into a space adjacent to you; it counts as an obstacle.
• Remove the Turret; move up to 3 spaces.
• Remove the Turret; you may retrieve a discarded card.

fields.name: Rapid Redeployment
fields.effect_text:
Choose one —
• Move up to 3 spaces and place the Turret into a space adjacent to you; it counts as an obstacle.
• Defeat a minion adjacent to you.

fields.name: Makeshift Minigun
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range of both you and the Turret. If the target is in a straight line from you, and in a straight line from the Turret, gain +2 :attack: Attack.

fields.name: Disruptor Jolt
fields.effect_text: This turn: Before any enemy hero in radius of the Turret performs a primary action, that hero discards a card, if able; if they discard a card, deactivate this effect.

fields.name: Early Prototype
fields.effect_text: If you are in radius of the Turret, swap with a unit or a token in radius of the Turret, then remove the Turret.

fields.name: Unlimited Firepower
fields.effect_text: Gain +1 :range: Range and +1 :radius: Radius.

fields.name: Throwing Spear
fields.effect_text:
Choose one —
• Target a unit adjacent to you.
• You may discard a card. If you have a card in the discard, target a unit in range.

fields.name: Furious Charge
fields.effect_text: Before the attack: Move 2, 3, or 4 spaces in a straight line to a space adjacent to an enemy unit, then target that unit.

fields.name: Master Skald
fields.effect_text: A friendly hero in range gains 2 coins; if any hero was defeated this round, that friendly hero gains 4 coins instead.

fields.name: Fortify
fields.effect_text: This round: When any friendly minion in radius is defeated you may discard a basic card. If you do, the minion is not removed.

fields.name: Counterattack
fields.effect_text: An enemy hero adjacent to you who has played an attack card this turn discards a card, or is defeated.

fields.name: Savage Kick
fields.effect_text: Move up to 2 spaces. Push an enemy unit or a token adjacent to you up to 2 spaces.

fields.name: Throwing Axe
fields.effect_text:
Choose one —
• Target a unit adjacent to you.
• You may discard a card; if you do, target a unit in range.

fields.name: Bullrush
fields.effect_text: Before the attack: Move 2 or 3 spaces in a straight line to a space adjacent to an enemy unit, then target that unit.

fields.name: War Drummer
fields.effect_text: A friendly hero in range gains 1 coin; if any hero was defeated this round, that friendly hero gains 3 coins instead.

fields.name: Bolster
fields.effect_text: This round: When any friendly minion in radius is defeated you may discard a silver card. If you do, the minion is not removed.

fields.name: Shield Bash
fields.effect_text: An enemy hero adjacent to you who has played an attack card this turn discards a card, if able.

fields.name: Mighty Punch
fields.effect_text: You may move 1 space. Push an enemy unit or a token adjacent to you up to 2 spaces.

fields.name: Bulwark
fields.effect_text:
You may retrieve a discarded card.
This turn: You and friendly units in radius cannot be moved, pushed, swapped or placed by enemy heroes.

fields.name: Onslaught
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. After the attack: Move into the space it occupied, if able.

fields.name: Shield
fields.effect_text:
This round: When any friendly minion in radius is defeated you may discard a silver card. If you do, the minion is not removed.
(The enemy hero still gains the coins for defeating the minion.)

fields.name: Brutal Jab
fields.effect_text: You may move 1 space. Push an enemy unit or a token adjacent to you up to 1 space.

fields.name: Mad Dash
fields.effect_text:
Before the attack: Move 2 spaces in a straight line to a space adjacent to an enemy unit, then target that unit.
(If you cannot make this move, you cannot attack.)

fields.name: One Man Army
fields.effect_text: During minion battle you count as a heavy minion; if you would be removed, lose the push instead.

fields.name: Ebb and Flow
fields.effect_text: Swap with an enemy minion in range; if it was adjacent to you, may repeat once.

fields.name: Stranger Tide
fields.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in range without a spawn point.

fields.name: Deluge
fields.effect_text: This turn: Enemy heroes in radius cannot fast travel, or move more than 1 space with a movement action.

fields.name: Master Duelist
fields.effect_text: Ignore all minion defense modifiers. This round: You are immune to attack actions of all enemy heroes, except this attacker.

fields.name: Violent Torrent
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. Before the attack: Up to 1 enemy hero in any of the 5 spaces in a straight line directly behind the target discards a card, or is defeated. May repeat once on a different unit.

fields.name: Tidal Blast
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range. After the attack: You may push an enemy unit adjacent to you up to 3 spaces.

fields.name: Arcane Whirlpool
fields.effect_text: Swap with an enemy minion in range.

fields.name: Magical Current
fields.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in range without a spawn point and not adjacent to an empty spawn point.

fields.name: Expert Duelist
fields.effect_text: Ignore all minion defense modifiers. This turn: You are immune to attack actions of all enemy heroes, except this attacker.

fields.name: Slippery Ground
fields.effect_text: This turn: Enemy heroes adjacent to you cannot fast travel, or move more than 1 space with a movement action.

fields.name: Rogue Wave
fields.effect_text: Target a unit in range. After the attack: You may push an enemy unit adjacent to you up to 2 spaces.

fields.name: Raging Stream
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. Before the attack: Up to 1 enemy hero in any of the 3 spaces in a straight line directly behind the target discards a card, or is defeated.

fields.name: Spell Break
fields.effect_text: This turn: Enemy heroes in radius cannot perform skill actions, except on gold cards.

fields.name: Noble Blade
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. Before the attack: You may move another unit that is adjacent to the target 1 space.

fields.name: Aspiring Duelist
fields.effect_text: Ignore all minion defense modifiers.

fields.name: Dangerous Current
fields.effect_text: Target a unit adjacent to you. Before the attack: Up to 1 enemy hero in any of the 2 spaces in a straight line directly behind the target discards a card, or is defeated.

fields.name: Liquid Leap
fields.effect_text: Place yourself into a space in range without a spawn point and not adjacent to an empty spawn point.

fields.name: Living Tsunami
fields.effect_text: Once per turn, before performing an Attack action, you may move 1 space.
